releaseNotes: HWM 0.2.5.10 contains service 0.2.5.9. Fixes stale ESET antivirus labels when Microsoft Defender is actively protecting the endpoint. After the updater verifies a successful service start, pilot workstations move to Stable and both pilot and stable workstations register a 15 minute SYSTEM update check. Existing updater mutex and maintenance window remain in effect. Terminal, Mesh recovery, tray 1.0.0.6 and updater binary remain unchanged.
